title: Minecraft Skin Studio
description: Run mcskin-artist lint scoring and multi-view/multi-pose 3D review renders from the settings panel, and give the agent skin_lint / skin_render tools.

filePlaceholder.en: Absolute path to a skin PNG, e.g. C:\Users\me\skin.png
filePlaceholder.zh: 皮肤 PNG 的绝对路径，例如 C:\Users\me\skin.png

needFile.en: Enter a skin PNG path first
needFile.zh: 请先填写皮肤 PNG 的绝对路径

skin_lint.en: Lint a Minecraft skin PNG (64x64 or 64x32): 13 checks, 0-100 score, A/B/C/D grade with per-check evidence. Read-only.
skin_lint.zh: 对 Minecraft 皮肤 PNG（64×64 或 64×32）跑质量评分：13 项检查、0-100 分、A/B/C/D 等级与逐项证据。只读。

skin_render.en: Render a Minecraft skin into multi-view (8) and multi-pose (4) PNG review sheets plus high-resolution texture crops.
skin_render.zh: 把 Minecraft 皮肤渲染成多视角（8 张）与多姿态（4 帧）PNG 审查图集，并输出贴图高清裁切。
